task_description.overview: Load seismogram data from a file in formats like SAC, MiniSEED, GSE2, etc., into an ObsPy Stream object.
steps: Call obspy.read() with the file path or URL of the seismogram.
Verify that the returned object is a Stream containing one or more Trace objects.
Inspect the Stream summary to confirm sample rate and time span.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the seismogram file located at {seismogram_path}. Visualize the original seismogram data. 
 Note: 1) Save the waveform plot to {result_plot}.
